title: calandrinia strophiolata
intro: Calandrinia strophiolata, commonly known as the 'Rocky Desert Cress', is a succulent plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is known for its edible leaves, which can be used as a salad green or added to various dishes for their nutritional value. The leaves of Calandrinia strophiolata are rich in vitamins and minerals, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The plant's therapeutic actions are primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
